## Activity

During May 2021, Market Eye Clinic recorded 303 captures. This represents the activity submitted by the site during the month for image review and grading. The capture total provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 303 captures, 15 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.0. These images could not be used for grading. The result should be monitored as part of routine site operations, with attention given to any recurring issues affecting image capture or review.

The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. This will support follow-up and help maintain consistent image quality at Market Eye Clinic.

## Grading

Grading identified 72 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1. This indicates the typical interval between the image being captured and the grading outcome being recorded. The grading activity and turnaround should continue to be reviewed alongside the capture volume and ungradable results.
